name: Machine Answerability Audit Skills
description: A provider-neutral, deterministic audit skill marketplace that evaluates how well an AI agent can find, read, understand, trust, act upon, and continue a task on any website.

runtime.network: one read-only HTTP GET per audited URL

skills.name: Audit Orchestrator
skills.description: Single composition and entrypoint layer: fetch once (respecting robots.txt), observe once, execute specialist audits, aggregate and deduplicate findings, map objectives, prioritize, and emit the final structured report.

skills.name: Machine Answerability Audit
skills.description: Evaluates whether key website information can be found, read, and understood reliably by AI systems, based on observed structure, visible text, images, and structured metadata.

skills.name: Task Readiness Audit
skills.description: Evaluates whether a page structurally supports an agent actually completing a task — navigable actions, actionable endpoints, structured workflows, reachable authentication, and sufficient decision evidence.

skills.name: Engagement Audit
skills.description: Evaluates post-click orientation and task continuity for users arriving from an AI referral or recommendation — whether the landing page supports orienting the visitor and continuing their intended task.

skills.name: Freshness & Corroboration Audit
skills.description: Evaluates whether the facts on a page are internally consistent and whether available freshness signals give an agent reason to treat time-sensitive facts as current.

skills.name: Evidence & Consistency Audit
skills.description: Extracts and preserves provider-neutral evidence facts (price, availability, name, brand, dates, attributes) into a shared FactInventory, then classifies each evidence group across representations (MATCH/CONFLICT/HISTORICAL/AMBIGUOUS/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE), reporting only meaningful conflicts.
skills.note: Implemented in src/audits/evidence_consistency.py and registered in the orchestrator under 'evidence_consistency' as part of the default six-audit pipeline.

skills.name: Crawl / Render Audit
skills.description: Evaluates whether technical delivery, accessibility, or rendering characteristics prevent automated agents and crawlers from reliably accessing and extracting content (CR-001 access failure, CR-002 limited initial HTML / client-side render gap, CR-003 problematic redirect downgrade, CR-004 invalid canonical declaration).
skills.note: Implemented in src/audits/crawl_render.py and registered in the orchestrator under 'crawl_render' as part of the default six-audit pipeline.

note: Skill list reflects current implementation state. Skills are registered in the audit orchestrator under stable names; all listed skills are implemented and run by default.
